name: Ace Quick Out Right
purpose: Three steps and out. The flanker breaks to the sideline at five yards where no linebacker can reach him, and the tight end sits down underneath if the throw is not there.

X.rule: Run straight downfield and take your defender with you.

LT.rule: Fire out at the man over you and keep him in front of you.

LG.rule: Fire out at the man over you and keep him in front of you.

C.rule: Snap and block the man over you. If nobody is over you, help to the backside.

RG.rule: Fire out at the man over you and keep him in front of you.

RT.rule: Fire out at the man over you and keep him in front of you.

TE.rule: Release inside, run five yards, and sit down facing the quarterback. You are the safety valve.

W.rule: Run straight downfield. Take your defender away from the middle.

Z.rule: Run five yards straight upfield, then break flat to the sideline. Look for the ball the instant you turn.

QB.rule: Three steps and throw to the flanker breaking out. If he is covered, come back to the tight end sitting down. Never hold it.

TB.rule: Check for anybody coming free, then release to the flat on the backside as the last option.

coaching_points: The ball comes out on the third step whether or not he is open. Count it in practice.
A throw to the sideline that falls incomplete is a fine outcome. A sack is not.
Best call against a defense that has walked everybody into the box to stop our runs.
